text:
Situation: Nitrofurantoin oral suspension is in short supply. FDA's shortage list records Amneal Pharmaceuticals discontinuing the product with an initial posting date of 2026-04-10. Corvale East holds 353 units at 13.7 units per day for 26 days of supply. Corvale General holds 409 units at 15.9 units per day for 26 days of supply. Corvale Lakeside holds 29 units at 2.5 units per day for 11 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows Amneal Pharmaceuticals discontinuing nitrofurantoin oral suspension, initial posting 2026-04-10. The product label we hold names Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as manufacturer with FEI 3004956904 and a most recent inspection classification of NAI on 2024-07-26. FDA inspection history for that FEI shows a series of VAI classifications from 2010-05-15 through 2020-03-13.

Our position: Current inventory covers East and General for approximately 26 days and Lakeside for approximately 11 days. No alternative supplier is on FDA's shortage list today. Labels for ranked options do not name a plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with A-S Medication Solutions, Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Almatica Pharma LLC, Alvogen Inc., and American Health Packaging; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to request plant identification and inspection history from each supplier before commitment; requires buyer approval.
3. Pharmacy director to approve any purchase agreements and allocation plan across sites; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. P&T committee to review therapeutic alternatives if supply cannot be secured; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative formulations or changing prescribing patterns before supply options are exhausted and committee review is complete.
